## ChunkMesh  (type-only)
interface ChunkMesh extends MeshReply {
    chunk: number;
    buffer: ArrayBuffer;
    vertexCount: number;
    indexCount: number;
    indexOffset: number;
    bounds: MeshBounds;
}

interface ChunkMeshOut {
    vertices: Float32Array;
    indices: Uint32Array;

    indexCount: number;
    bounds: MeshBounds;
}

## MeshChunkOptions  (type-only)
interface MeshChunkOptions {
    ao?: boolean;
    aoCurve?: ArrayLike<number>;
    layerOf?: (block: number, face: VoxelFace) => number;
    outside?: number | ((x: number, y: number, z: number) => number);
}

## VOXEL_VERTEX_FLOATS
const VOXEL_VERTEX_FLOATS = 12;

## VOXEL_WGSL
const VOXEL_WGSL = "\nfn voxel_layer(color: vec4f) -> u32 {\n  return u32(round(max(color.a, 0.0)));\n}\n\nfn voxel_ao(color: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return color.r;\n}\n\nfn voxel_uv_wrap(uv: vec2f) -> vec2f {\n  return fract(uv);\n}\n";

## VoxelFace  (type-only)
type VoxelFace = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

## VoxelGrid  (type-only)
interface VoxelGrid {
    readonly sizeX: number;
    readonly sizeY: number;
    readonly sizeZ: number;
    readonly chunk: number;
    readonly chunksX: number;
    readonly chunksY: number;
    readonly chunksZ: number;
    readonly chunkCount: number;
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    readonly version: number;
    readonly dirty: Uint8Array;
    inBounds(x: number, y: number, z: number): boolean;
    index(x: number, y: number, z: number): number;
    get(x: number, y: number, z: number, outside?: number): number;
    set(x: number, y: number, z: number, block: number): boolean;
    setMany(cells: ArrayLike<number>): number;
    fill(fn: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => number): void;
    chunkAt(x: number, y: number, z: number): number;
    chunkIndex(cx: number, cy: number, cz: number): number;
    chunkCoords(chunk: number, out: number[] | Float32Array | Int32Array): void;
    chunkEmpty(chunk: number): boolean;
    isDirty(chunk: number): boolean;
    markDirty(chunk: number): void;
    markAllDirty(): void;
    clearDirty(chunk: number): void;
    forEachDirtyChunk(fn: (chunk: number) => void): number;
    serialize(): ArrayBuffer;
    deserialize(buffer: ArrayBuffer): void;
    subscribe(listener: VoxelGridListener): () => void;
}

## VoxelMesherRequest  (type-only)
type VoxelMesherRequest = {
    type: 'grid';
    buffer: ArrayBuffer;
} | {
    type: 'set';
    x: number;
    y: number;
    z: number;
    block: number;
} | {
    type: 'mesh';
    chunk: number;
};

## VoxelWorkerLike  (type-only)
interface VoxelWorkerLike {
    postMessage(message: VoxelMesherRequest, transfer?: Transferable[]): void;
    addEventListener(type: 'message', listener: (e: {
        data: unknown;
    }) => void): void;
    removeEventListener(type: 'message', listener: (e: {
        data: unknown;
    }) => void): void;
}
